plan.purpose: Check whether reducing the same case1 material parameterization to one contrast changes fixed-budget recovery while preserving the prior optimizer settings
plan.data_access: Author case1 development only; no operator validation/test, new final test or independent physics
plan.geometry: Known truth support material1<0.5 (339 physical cells); fixed gamma=1 outside support, original ghost/source/receiver handling
plan.primary_intervention: Replace the free-pixel gamma parameter with a single scalar a; no new regularizer or network
plan.optimizer: Adam lr0.02, correct time cost multiplied by 1e12, gradient norm clip1e-5, clamp a to [gamma0,1], 35 updates
plan.evaluation: Save all 36 states; final35 main result, no truth-selected stopping. Report contrast, waveform relative L2, correct time cost and physical-grid material half MSE
plan.checks: Verify reconstructed initial fields against prior four-arm initial states; audit scalar chain-rule gradient with positive unprojected float64 finite differences before updates; check optimizer steps, finite values, fixed support and endpoint prediction reload
plan.comparison: Compare with previously saved free-pixel four arms using identical observations, initial fields and fixed budget. Scalar clipping and Adam occur in a different coordinate system, so this is a parameterization control, not an isolated optimizer improvement
plan.interpretation: Known geometry is diagnostic oracle information; success cannot be claimed as blind FWI, geometry recovery or final generalization
plan.follow_up: Only after this result choose separately between accepted-step optimization, coarser unknown-geometry parameterization or local FNO material-family work
